Package APIs, generated schemas, CLI subcommands, HTTP routes, events, artifact formats, plugins, scripts, adapters, and external consumers still require per-repository owner discovery.
Configured deployment references and current live consumers were not queried.
Local branch/HEAD may not equal canonical remote default branch.
Owner mappings marked owner-unconfirmed are provisional seed values.
Private local repositories are intentionally not enumerated in this public source artifact; their existence and contents are not inferred from exclusion.
source_method.revision_semantics: git_head identifies checked-out commit; evidence file hashes identify the exact local bytes read, which may include uncommitted changes; worktree_dirty records whether any local change was present
source_method.scope: selected immediate-child Git repositories under /projects/dev; local checkouts only; no network, credentials, cluster, production state, or runtime consumer observation
source_method.visibility_method: Canonical GitHub REST repos/{owner}/{repo} visibility queried for local names; only public/private/internal enums were retained. No API response bodies, credentials, or remote URLs were saved.
